newsitem.title: USA: Vermont plans $38 mln bond sale in Nov or Dec.
newsitem.headline: Vermont plans $38 mln bond sale in Nov or Dec.

text.p: Vermont state Treasurer James Douglas said Monday the state tentatively plans to sell $38 million of general obligation debt competitively before the end of the year.
Douglas, speaking at the Bond Buyer New England public finance conference here, said the state in addition would likely issue $15 million of small denomination bonds in December or January.
In March or April, the Vermont Economic Development Authority could sell up to $17 million of bonds, depending on market conditions, Douglas said.
Vermont's neighbor, New Hamsphire, is also watching the market.

New Hampshire state Treasurer Georgie Thomas told conference attendees, "We will be back in the market in the spring for another savings bond issue." She added other debt sales, including commercial paper for capital programs, are tentative.
Both treasurers spoke on a panel in the morning session of the conference.
